# Instructions for GitHub Copilot

Before doing anything, read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) in the root of the repository: it has the rules and
the way of working of this project (Spec-Driven Development, D-025).

The most important ones: ask every doubt and write a plan before writing any code, wait for an explicit "yes" from
the member, work only on your sub-issue, and never commit to `main` or `develop`.
